evals.name: mixed-changes-grouped
evals.prompt: I'm done for now, commit my changes please
evals.expected_output: Three separate Conventional Commits: a feat for the new PayPal provider (src/paypal.js), a fix for the Stripe rounding bug (src/payment.js), and a docs change for the README. Correct conventional types, lowercase imperative descriptions.

evals.name: breaking-api-change
evals.expected_output: A single Conventional Commit for the breaking getUser API change, marked breaking with a '!' before the colon and/or a 'BREAKING CHANGE:' footer.

evals.name: refactor-and-tests
evals.prompt: wrap up these changes into commits
evals.expected_output: Conventional Commits using the expanded vocabulary: a refactor commit for the cart.js helper extraction and a test commit (or grouped) for the added discount test. Should NOT use add/update/remove.

evals.name: routing-triggers
evals.prompt: I'm done for now, commit my changes please
evals.expected_output: git-commit loads and groups the working tree into separate logical Conventional Commits by functionality.

evals.name: routing-excludes-task-run
evals.prompt: build the dark-mode toggle end to end and open a PR
evals.expected_output: Running a whole unit of work through plan, implement, review and PR is task-run's job; git-commit must not load, because there is nothing to commit yet.
